verdict.summary: You can self-serve a free OAuth app and test with up to five production connections, but Core and above require app certification. Plan around certification and paid-tier gating before promising scale; journal, XPM, and bulk-connection use cases additionally require Advanced, a security assessment, and Xero use-case approval.
verdict.activeEffort: A free Xero account, demo company, and OAuth application are required to start.
verdict.waitTime: Xero does not publish an approval or certification SLA in the reviewed pricing and policy material.
verdict.mainGate: App certification is required for Core, Plus, Advanced and Enterprise.

steps.title: Create a Xero account, enable the demo company, and create an OAuth 2.0 application in My Apps

detail.text: Xero's starter onboarding requires developers to sign up for a free Xero account, enable a demo company, and add an OAuth 2.0 application.

sources.quote: sign up for a free Xero account, enable a demo company, and add an OAuth 2.0 application.

steps.title: Start on Starter and define the initial pilot cohort

detail.text: The Starter tier has unlimited data access to enable early innovation but is capped at 5 connections.

sources.quote: The Starter tier has unlimited data access to enable early innovation but is capped at 5 connections.

detail.text: Redirect URIs must be absolute URIs and wildcards are not supported.

sources.quote: The OAuth 2.0 spec (section 3.1.2 of RFC 6749) requires that a redirection URI must be an absolute URI. The use of wildcards in redirect URI is not supported.

steps.title: Validate the redirect-URI inventory across environments

detail.text: An app can use up to 50 redirect URIs.

sources.quote: You can use up to 50 redirect URIs for your app.

detail.text: Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 already use granular scopes.

sources.quote: Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 already use granular scopes.

steps.title: Design the AI data boundary and prohibit UI automation

detail.text: Data obtained through Xero APIs must not be used to train or contribute to the creation of any AI or machine learning model.

sources.quote: The primary update prohibits the use of data obtained through Xero’s APIs to train or contribute to the creation of any AI or machine learning model.

steps.title: Build and test the authorization-code OAuth flow using the app credentials

detail.text: Xero supports the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension to the authorization code flow.

sources.quote: Xero supports the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension to the authorization code flow.

steps.title: Implement token refresh, reauthorization, and callback-failure recovery

detail.text: Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days.

sources.quote: Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days.

steps.title: Test with the demo company and no more than five connected organisations

detail.text: The Starter tier has unlimited data access to enable early innovation but is capped at 5 connections.

sources.quote: The Starter tier has unlimited data access to enable early innovation but is capped at 5 connections.

steps.title: Apply for the required paid tier and submit certification materials before scaling beyond Starter

detail.text: App certification is required for Core, Plus, Advanced and Enterprise.

sources.quote: App certification is required for Core, Plus, Advanced and Enterprise

detail.text: Xero directs developers to separate certification documentation for details of the certification process.

sources.quote: More information about the Xero Developer certification process can be found here .

steps.title: If requesting journals, XPM, or bulk connections, submit the security assessment and use-case approval

detail.text: The Journals endpoint, Xero Practice Manager API, and Bulk Connections require a security assessment (initial and annual) and use case approval.

sources.quote: The Journals endpoint, Xero Practice Manager API, and Bulk Connections require a security assessment (initial and annual) and use case approval

steps.title: Add payment details and move to Core when a sixth organisation must connect

detail.text: In order to add a 6th connection, you will need to first add your payment details.

sources.quote: In order to add a 6th connection, you will need to first add your payment details.

steps.title: Select a tier based on connection scale and budget

detail.text: The published maximum connection counts are 5 for Starter, 50 for Core, 1,000 for Plus, 10,000 for Advanced, and no limit for Enterprise.

sources.quote: Connections (maximum) 5
Connections (maximum) 50
Connections (maximum) 1000
Connections (maximum) 10,000
Connections (maximum) No Limit

gotchas.text: The accounting.transactions scope is replaced by accounting.invoices, accounting.payments, accounting.banktransactions, and accounting.manualjournals.

sources.quote: The accounting.transactions scope is replaced by accounting.invoices, accounting.payments, accounting.banktransactions, and accounting.manualjournals.

gotchas.text: The accounting.journals.read scope requires the Advanced tier and certification.

sources.quote: accounting.journals.read is no longer granted by default. To access journals, you'll need the Advanced tier and certification.

gotchas.text: Access tokens last 30 minutes, so production integrations need refresh-token handling.

sources.quote: 30 minutes.

gotchas.text: If the callback fails for any reason, the user must be sent through the authorization flow again.

sources.quote: If the callback fails for any reason you will need to send the user through the auth flow again.

gotchas.text: Single-page apps are not currently supported.

sources.quote: Single page apps are not currently supported.

gotchas.text: Applications must not use bots or browser extensions to undermine security controls or simulate user actions.

sources.quote: apps must not use bots or browser extensions to undermine our security controls or simulate user actions.

gotchas.text: A Xero App Store listing is unavailable on Starter and Core, optional on Plus and Advanced, and required on Enterprise.

sources.quote: A Xero App Store listing is required for the Enterprise tier, recommended but optional for the Plus and Advanced tiers, and not available for the Starter and Core tiers.

whenBlocked.text: Remain within the five-connection Starter cap while testing, then add payment details before adding a sixth connection.

sources.quote: The Starter tier has unlimited data access to enable early innovation but is capped at 5 connections.
In order to add a 6th connection, you will need to first add your payment details.

whenBlocked.text: Apply to move between tiers through the developer portal.

sources.quote: Beginning 2 March, 2026, you can apply to move between tiers within the developer portal.

whenBlocked.text: For journal, XPM, or bulk-connection access, complete the required security assessment and obtain use-case approval.
